name: After recital F
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
part_text: Fb. whereas Haiti’s current crisis cannot be separated from the colonial indemnity imposed by France in 1825, which drained the country’s resources for over a century, nor from subsequent debt dependence, externally imposed economic policies and repeated foreign interference, in particular from the United States with no less than 15 years of occupation;
